title: I’ve finished everything I planned for the game. What’s next, and is it worth it? :)
author: Best-Improvement1745
selftext:
About four months ago, I shared the first version of my Minigolf game here, which was inspired by Gravity Defied, Bounce, and Worms. To acquire players, I used Meta targeted ads, which brought in a small audience. At that time, the game had around 20 levels. After that, I gradually added level after level, sent push notifications about updates to players, and step-by-step brought the total number of free levels up to 40. Throughout this period, the game maintained a low but stable level of activity (roughly 10–20 daily active users).  
Next, I sat down to develop a separate pack of 20 paid levels to test in practice whether people would be willing to pay for the game (spoiler: so far, nobody is willing to :)). Since I was working on the entire pack at once, no updates were released for a bit over a month; however, activity in the game still remained at that low yet steady level.  
So, given these numbers and data, what would you advise doing next?  
P.S. During the targeted ad campaign, D1 retention was around 25%. I don't recall D7, but it was extremely low.
